purpose: Companion mapping ledger for the Asana connector. This file makes source-backed runtime gaps visible; it is not an engine loader input and cannot block a mapped command by itself.

runtime_definition_files.role: source-only event-token transport for project-scoped tasks incremental append/upsert/dedupe; no Asana destination transport is claimed
reverse-ETL write actions, including multipart attachment variants
direct read and direct write operation declarations

etl.implementation: saved connections use streams.json with schemas/ for exhaustive full-refresh overwrite/append across all 12 streams; sync_transport.json admits only project-scoped tasks to the Asana Events token executor for incremental append/upsert/dedupe

reverse_etl.implementation: system-level pm reverse reads a local warehouse table and applies writes.json actions; no Asana destination sync transport or provider idempotency is claimed

direct_read.implementation: cli_surface.json binds 107 bounded operation-backed commands and 12 stream-backed commands. The stream-backed command route sets a record limit but no MaxPages/fanout request bound, so those 12 declarations do not yet satisfy the one-provider-request direct_read contract; saved ETL is unaffected.

direct_write.implementation: cli_surface.json binds 96 implemented one-record commands to writes.json; plan -> preview -> approval -> execute is preserved

binary_download.reason: The locked Asana source declares application/json response content for its operations and no binary response media contract. No binary-download command is invented.

foundations.reason: The 12 stream-backed interactive commands call Connector.Read with a record Limit but no MaxPages or fan-out request bound. Pagination may issue more than one provider request; sections, stories, and project_statuses additionally perform fan-out discovery and child reads. The commands remain mapped, but their current runtime route is not a bounded one-provider-request direct read.
does_not_block: saved full-refresh ETL for all 12 streams

foundations.reason: The locked Asana Events contract proves the implemented project-scoped tasks token window. It does not establish complete event scope/resource coverage for the other 11 streams and documents no total event ordering for history/change capture, so event_source_contract.json records event_total_order=not_documented and sync_transport.json deliberately admits only tasks incremental append/upsert/dedupe.
does_not_block: full-refresh overwrite and append for all 12 streams

foundations.reason: The existing file_upload operation is metadata-only. A direct-write executor needs an operation-level multipart request contract with a closed body and an explicit media policy; the locked Asana source intentionally does not publish a fixed file-media allow-list.
does_not_block: the equivalent direct-write and reverse-ETL attachment write actions

foundations.reason: The source documents multipart/form-data, full file content, and a 100 MB cap, but no fixed allowable media-type list. The public binary_upload intent requires that list, so declaring one would fabricate a provider contract.
does_not_block: the declared direct-write/reverse-ETL multipart file action

foundations.reason: Other currently planned Asana mutations still name cli-request-schema-foundation-r1 in their own existing JSON. Their source operations remain mapped; each needs its own closed write or operation request declaration before it can be executable.
does_not_block: the attachment mappings in this change

foundations.reason: One existing Asana mutation row names cli-openapi30-reference-sibling-foundation-r1. This is an importer/runtime declaration gap, not a reason to omit the source operation from mapping.

The current connectorgen source-projection parser rejects the enriched per-operation `source_operation` field with `json: unknown field source_operation`. This does not affect the embedded runtime bundle or the declared attachment commands; it only prevents the older source-projection validator from validating this richer lock format.

non_binding_files.role: closed source-lock evidence projection bound to sync_transport.json's registered executor; tests and certification consume its facts, but it contains no executable lifecycle or runtime policy
optional live-evidence configuration; it does not decide whether a source-backed operation is mapped or executable
immutable source provenance for mapping; it is not the runtime executor
